Insert one Table.ExpandColumn among Columns to choose its position; otherwise Ant Design places it automatically. State remains in this object; bind expandedRowKeys and update it from the top-level onExpandedRowsChange event for controlled expansion. Top-level render and event props take precedence over callbacks supplied in expandable.
expandedRowRender: slot — Row detail template receiving row, index, indent and expanded. Mapped to native expandable.expandedRowRender; takes precedence over a renderer in expandable. Use row fields in this slot. Configure Canvas expanded rows to show representative detail variants directly on the editing canvas. Selection does not broaden configured samples. When canvas samples are unset, selecting this slot or Edit contents reveals eligible rows without changing runtime expansion. Selecting the Table alone does not reveal rows. The canvas modifier-click gesture changes temporary keys. Requires data and a stable rowKey.
